policy: Existing typed graph projection; raw kinds retained. No edge is promoted to a proved implication or compatible interface.

scoped_relations.relation_coverage: Selected scoped relations and paired contracts only; no topic-based dependency or exhaustive search.

evidence.range_scope: Selected decisive theorem/proof/review passage; exact frozen bytes and inclusive range checked by root.
evidence.status: Root-selected frozen internal derivation/review/receipt; source_derived_unreviewed; external correctness, priority, physical capability UNKNOWN. Root-final curation retains that evidential level.

requires_external_validation.scope: Solve the globally quantified unrestricted PC criterion or produce a compatible negative Jensen law for the exact exposed ray. Preserve the final independent operator-scope audit and bounded priority comparison; additional heat-metric or SOS-only failures will not decide PC/QC.
